scope: Remove RoboTwin diagnostic from public AC-WM showcase
summary: The rejected RoboTwin comparison was moved out of demo/showcase and retained only under internal evaluation evidence; the public AC-WM demo now points to the real EPIC-KITCHENS P03_28 scene.
evidence: The moved internal artifact retains SHA-256 49c738bdda47e3fc8a98bb0ff7a2a14639ca7ec05f516537b358e9c8c93b44c5.
The public source-plus-results EPIC video is 240 frames at 24 FPS with SHA-256 32f739a369e7325073dc2d68b7d1c952b56bba1451cea47741efeb1549d2cadf.
lessons: Simulator diagnostics must not be used as the public demonstration when the acceptance target requires recorded real-world scenes.
limitations: The EPIC output remains a generated camera-frame action visualization, not calibrated physical-robot execution.
next_actions: Use real robot-action datasets and physical execution telemetry for the next model-training and hardware-validation stage.
